title: Heart-Healthy Turkey Bacon & Spinach Quiche
ingredients: 6 slices lean turkey bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
4 cups fresh baby spinach, wilted and squeezed dry (or 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and drained)
4 large whole eggs + 4 large egg whites
1 cup low-fat milk (or unsweetened almond/evaporated skim milk)
3/4 cup reduced-fat shredded Swiss or part-skim mozzarella cheese
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
1 whole-wheat 9-inch pie crust (or bake crustless in a lightly greased pie dish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly coat a 9-inch pie dish with olive oil spray (or line with whole-wheat crust).
Crisp the turkey bacon in a non-stick skillet, remove and crumble. In the same pan, sauté diced onion, garlic, and spinach until tender and dry.
Layer the spinach-onion mixture, crumbled turkey bacon, and shredded Swiss/mozzarella cheese in the pie dish.

Whisk together the eggs, egg whites, low-fat milk, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper. Pour over the filling and bake for 35–40 minutes until golden and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
